events.verdict: Cunningham (DET) goes to, not through, Williams (DAL) and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Washington (DAL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Cunningham's (DET) driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Mavericks (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Duren (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Play resumes with Dallas retaining the possession.
Harris (DET) extends his right hand and initiates contact with Dinwiddie's (DAL) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Washington (DAL) makes incidental hand-on-ball contact with Cunningham (DET) that dislodges the ball away during his drive.
Duren (DET) makes contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it away from Jones (DAL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Jones (DAL) jumps from point A to point B and makes more than marginal contact with Schroder's (DET) body, which affects his follow-through after releasing the driving shot attempt.

Thompson (DET) makes contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it away from Thompson (DAL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring. Although this is a legal play, the shot clock should be reset after Thompson steals the ball.
Cunningham (DET) extends his right hand and makes contact with Washington's (DAL) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Beasley (DET) extends his right hand and delivers contact to Dinwiddie's (DAL) arm, which affects his SQBR.
Duren (DET) extends both hands and initiates illegal contact to Williams' (DAL) body during the driving shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) steps up to defend and incidental foot-to-foot contact occurs with Cunningham (DET) during his driving shot attempt.
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on Thompson (DAL).
